data.gender_notes: Atalya is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek goddess Atalanta, whose name means 'she who brings forth'. In mythology, she is a huntress and virgin goddess. This name also appears in the Bible as the name of a woman in the Old Testament. The name Atalya carries the meaning “Goddess Atalanta” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Atalya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess atalanta and live with faith, good character and purpose.
